description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Document Management API in the Fineract project, including response classes and a request class for uploading documents.

classes.name: DocumentManagementApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes representing Swagger documentation models for document management API responses and requests.

classes.name: PostEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Response class for posting entity documents, includes resourceId and resourceIdentifier.

classes.name: PutEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Response class for updating entity documents, includes resourceId, resourceIdentifier, and change details.

classes.name: PutEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponseChangesSwagger
classes.description: Nested class representing changes in the update response.

classes.name: DeleteEntityTypeEntityIdDocumentsResponse
classes.description: Response class for deleting entity documents, includes resourceId and resourceIdentifier.

classes.name: DocumentUploadRequest
classes.description: Request class for uploading documents, extends UploadRequest, includes name and description fields with getters and setters.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the document to upload.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the document to upload.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the document.
